travel.title: Japan Travel Guide
travel.subtitle: Explore the Beauty of Japan
travel.disclaimer: Information is for reference only. Please verify details before traveling.

tokyo.name: Tokyo
tokyo.desc: Japan's capital and largest city. A dazzling mix of cutting-edge tech, ancient temples, world-class dining, and endless entertainment.
tokyo.tips: Nepali restaurants and grocery stores are found in Shinjuku and Ikebukuro. Get an IC card (Suica/Pasmo) for easy transit.

plan.title: 3-Day Sample Itinerary
plan.day1: Meiji Shrine (1.5h) → Harajuku / Takeshita Street → Shibuya Scramble Crossing → Shinjuku / Metropolitan Gov't Bldg (free view)
plan.day2: Asakusa / Senso-ji Temple (1.5h) → Sumida River Cruise (45min) → Odaiba → Akihabara
plan.day3: Ueno Park / Tokyo National Museum → Ginza Shopping → Tokyo Tower night view

kyoto.name: Kyoto
kyoto.desc: Japan's ancient capital. Over 1,000 years of history with magnificent temples, geisha culture, traditional gardens, and bamboo forests.
kyoto.tips: Most beautiful during cherry blossom season (Mar–Apr) and autumn foliage (Nov). Book accommodations well in advance.

plan.title: 3-Day Sample Itinerary
plan.day1: Kiyomizu-dera Temple (1.5h) → Higashiyama / Ninenzaka & Sannenzaka → Philosopher's Path → Gion / Pontocho for dinner
plan.day2: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove (1.5h) → Tenryu-ji Temple → Kinkaku-ji Golden Pavilion (1h) → Ryoan-ji Rock Garden
plan.day3: Fushimi Inari Shrine / Thousand Torii Gates (early morning) → Nishiki Market → Nijo Castle (UNESCO)

highlights.fushimi: Fushimi Inari — Thousands of Torii Gates

osaka.name: Osaka
osaka.desc: Japan's food capital! Try takoyaki, okonomiyaki, and kushikatsu. Experience the vibrant nightlife of Dotonbori.
osaka.tips: Meals are generally cheaper than Tokyo and incredibly tasty. Great base for day trips to Kyoto and Nara.

plan.title: 2-Day Sample Itinerary
plan.day1: Osaka Castle (2h) → Shinsekai / Tsutenkaku Tower (1.5h) → Dotonbori evening street food (takoyaki, kushikatsu)
plan.day2: Kuromon Market breakfast (fresh seafood) → Umeda Sky Building observation deck → Shinsaibashi shopping → departure

hokkaido.name: Hokkaido
hokkaido.desc: Japan's northernmost major island. Vast nature, fresh produce, and world-class ski resorts. Lavender fields in summer, snow festivals in winter.
hokkaido.tips: Niseko is a favorite among Nepali skiers. Don't miss Hokkaido ramen and fresh butter corn.

plan.title: 3-4 Day Sample Itinerary
plan.day1: Arrive Sapporo → Odori Park (1h) → Clock Tower (30min) → Susukino Ramen Alley for dinner
plan.day2: Furano lavender fields (summer, 3h) or Niseko ski resort (winter, full day) → Biei rolling hills drive
plan.day3: Otaru Canal (2h) → Otaru Market fresh seafood lunch → Yoichi Whisky Distillery tour

fuji.name: Mt. Fuji
fuji.desc: Japan's iconic symbol, a 3,776m active volcano. Climbable July–August. Enjoy stunning views and hot springs in nearby Hakone.
fuji.tips: Relatively manageable for Nepali mountain trekkers. Climbing starts at the 5th Station. Don't skip the Hakone onsen experience!

plan.title: 1-2 Day Sample Itinerary
plan.day1: Lake Kawaguchiko viewpoint (early morning Mt. Fuji reflection) → Fuji 5th Station (2h, climbing Jul–Aug only) → Hakone / Owakudani → Onsen ryokan

nara.name: Nara
nara.desc: Japan's first permanent capital. Famous for friendly wild deer and the massive Todai-ji temple. Perfect for a day trip from Kyoto or Osaka.
nara.tips: Buy shika-senbei (deer crackers) and feed the deer! You can cover all major spots in a single day.

plan.title: Day Trip Itinerary
plan.day1: Kintetsu Nara Station → Todai-ji / Great Buddha (1.5h) → Nara Park deer feeding (1h) → Kasuga-Taisha Shrine (1h) → Naramachi stroll → Return to Kyoto/Osaka

hiroshima.name: Hiroshima
hiroshima.desc: A symbol of peace and resilience. UNESCO Peace Memorial Park and the iconic floating torii gate of Miyajima Island.
hiroshima.tips: The Peace Memorial Museum is a moving and essential visit. Try Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki — layered differently from Tokyo!

plan.title: 2-Day Sample Itinerary
plan.day1: Peace Memorial Park / Atomic Bomb Dome (2h) → Peace Memorial Museum (1.5h) → Hiroshima okonomiyaki lunch → Hiroshima Castle (1h)
plan.day2: Miyajima Island / Itsukushima Shrine & floating torii (3h) → local momiji manju dessert → Mt. Misen cable car views

okinawa.name: Okinawa
okinawa.desc: Japan's southernmost tropical island group. Crystal-clear emerald waters, colorful coral reefs, and the unique Ryukyu Kingdom culture.
okinawa.tips: Avoid the rainy season (May–Jun). Must-try: fresh seafood and Okinawa soba. Don't forget sunscreen!

plan.title: 2-3 Day Sample Itinerary
plan.day1: Shurijo Castle / Ryukyu culture (2h) → Kokusai-dori International Street shopping → Okinawan dinner (goya champuru)
plan.day2: Churaumi Aquarium whale sharks (3h) → Kouri Island blue heart rock (2h) → snorkeling experience
